text:
Maya R: Heads up — external security assessment kicks off Mon (vendor on site). They said initial findings PDF will land during the window. Need to plan: RBAC temporary roles, KMS access for evidence export, audit log retention check, vuln triage owner, and retest coordination. Who can own what?
Sam W: I'll take the RBAC change plan. Quick Q: do we want a scoped ephemeral role scoped to 'assessment-readonly' + evidence-write?
Priya K: For SIEM/audit, confirm retention: current logstore has 90d retention. Vendor asked for 6 months of relevant API logs. We need an export or extended retention for the assessment window.
Oliver J: For KMS, we'll need a presigned S3 bucket + KMS grant. I can script a short runbook. Example AWS CLI snippet for ephemeral grant: ```bash
# create key grant for assessor role
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-prod-evidence --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-temp --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey 
```
Ben L: I'm setting up the vuln-triage board and labels. Link once ready: https://kanban.internal/redwood/sec-assess-1719 (will add templates: p0/p1 remediation/verification).
Carla H: I can own remediation triage during the window. I'll create tickets for each finding, assign to service owners, and track ETA + verification steps.
Dinesh P: Proposed RBAC JSON (short): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-assessment-evidence/*","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"]
  }]
}
```
Maya R: @Sam W / @Dinesh P — can we make that ephemeral role expire automatically after 72h and require a 2FA approval flow? Vendor needs at least 48-72h access windows.
Sam W: yep, we can provision with STS AssumeRole + session duration 43200s (12h) and rotate creds every 12h for the vendor. We'll add a short Slack approval workflow via the approval app.
Priya K: For logs, options: (1) one-off export of 6 months to a secured bucket + presigned link for reviewer, (2) temporary retention increase for relevant log index. I prefer export + checksum to reduce blast radius.
Oliver J: I'll own the KMS presigned bucket + Grant lifecycle. I'll add steps: create bucket, enforce bucket policy (deny non-VPC), create KMS grant scoped to assessor role, and document key usage.
sec-bot: Automated: created incident-tracker ticket INC-2024-1719 and attached initial intake form (uploaded by Maya R).
Ben L: Board live: added columns "incoming findings", "triage", "in-progress fix", "awaiting retest", "closed". Carla, I gave you board admin.
Carla H: Starting triage now. If any findings touch keys/KMS or RBAC, flag them P0 and ping @Dinesh P + @Sam W immediately.
Dinesh P: For retest coordination: propose weekly retest slots on Wed/Thu during the next 3 weeks. We can block 2x 90m windows for rapid verification. Anyone opposed?
Maya R: That works. I'll coordinate with vendor for exact times. Action list: Sam/Dinesh: ephemeral RBAC + approval workflow. Oliver: KMS bucket + grant runbook. Priya: log export + checksum plan. Ben: triage board + templates. Carla: remediation lead and verification notes. I'll be point for vendor scheduling and retest calendar.
Sam W: I'll post a mini-runbook in #eng-security/runbooks when ready.
Priya K: I'll start export job and share signed checksum in the board ticket.
Oliver J: Will upload kms-grant steps + commands. Also recommend we rotate the evidence key once the engagement completes.
Carla H: I'll create a tidy label set: "assess-p0","assess-p1","needs-retest" and begin assigning owners.
Maya R: Thanks team — please mark your tickets with the thread_ts 1719004321 so I can correlate. We aim for initial evidence/handoff by Mon EOD.
Ben L: noted. I'll add automation to tag tickets with the thread id.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: vendor-access-window opens 2024-05-06T09:00Z — access revocation scheduled 2024-05-09T09:00Z.
Maya R: Closing loop: will run a 15m sync Mon 08:30 to confirm intake and any immediate blockers. If something urgent crops up before then, DM me and ping @here. :thumbsup:
